subject: knitr not writing over existing pdf files

messages.author: 9ec69ca07f36d6a1
messages.subject: knitr not writing over existing pdf files
parts:
Lately using R 3.1.1 and knitr 1.8 when I run knit() and pdf files already exist from a previous run of knit(), I get new pdf files created, with names such as oldname-1.pdf.  Does anyone know why this new behavior came about and how to prevent it?

Thanks
Frank

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr not writing over existing pdf files
parts:
That is due to a change in knitr since 1.7:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr/releases See the second bullet in the
section Major Changes of knitr 1.7. I also provided a function to
clean up oldname.pdf there.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
